Continuous production, which runs nonstop on one product
Assembly-line production, which follows a fixed sequence
Mass production, which makes large volumes of identical items

questions.explanation: A job shop is designed for low-volume, high-variety work where each order follows a different path. Mass, continuous, and assembly-line processes rely on standardization and repetition that custom orders do not allow.
questions.hint: High variety and low volume point to a job shop.
